title: Iceweb
author: Gil Williamson
description:
A beginner-level text-only Infocom-style game with a cyberpunk theme.

It was written for the e-zine Mythaxis (issue 17 Feb 2016), where it was published with a Parchment framework and is playable on-line via a browser.

A .zblorb has been uploaded to ifarchive.
